title: [Shoulder dislocation in athletes].
journal: Der Chirurg; Zeitschrift fur alle Gebiete der operativen Medizen

sections.label: BACKGROUND
sections.text: Shoulder dislocation is a common injury in athletes. Surgical and non-surgical therapy options are still the subject of controversial debate.

sections.label: STUDY AIM
sections.text: This article presents important considerations for decision-making and current concepts for the therapy of shoulder dislocation in athletes.

sections.label: METHODS
sections.text: A selective literature search was carried out in PubMed.

sections.label: RESULTS
sections.text: Surgical and non-surgical therapy options are described in the literature without yet defining a gold standard.

sections.label: CONCLUSION
sections.text: Early surgical stabilization is currently recommended in young athletes. For decision-making numerous sport and patient-related factors need to be considered. Most athletes are able to return to the pre-injury level after surgical stabilization.
